en.name: Baby food jars and pouches
en.summary: Unopened jars and pouches should be discarded after the use-by date printed on them. Once opened, they keep 2–3 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below — and only if you have never fed from the container itself.
en.pantry: An unopened jar or pouch is commercially processed and shelf-stable to its use-by date; after that date it should be discarded rather than assessed by eye. No separate pantry figure is given, because the date on the container is the manufacturer's own statement about their own product. Keep them somewhere cool and dark, and inspect every one before opening: a lid whose vacuum button clicks when pressed, a pouch that is swollen, leaking or damaged, or any pack that hisses or spurts on opening goes straight in the bin unopened or unused.
en.fridge: 2–3 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once opened, covered — at the shorter end for meat and vegetable varieties, and the longer end for acidic fruit. The rule that matters more than the number is the spoon. Never feed straight from the jar or pouch with a spoon that has been in the baby's mouth: saliva carries bacteria and enzymes into the remainder, which then spoils quickly and cannot safely be kept. Spoon out a portion into a bowl, feed from the bowl, and throw away whatever is left in it. The same applies to a pouch fed directly from the spout.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for opened jars and pouches, and commercial purées separate badly when frozen and thawed. Freezing your own purées in an ice cube tray, then bagging the cubes, is a sensible and common practice — but label them, keep the window short, and do not borrow a number from another food. Never refreeze a portion that has been thawed, warmed or fed from.
en.thawing: Thaw a frozen home-made portion in the fridge, never on the counter, and warm it once. Stir it and test it on your wrist before feeding; warmed purée develops hot spots that will scald.
spoilage: A vacuum button that clicks when pressed — discard the jar without opening it.
A swollen, leaking or damaged pouch, or any hissing or spurting on opening.
A sour, fermented or off smell, or fizzing in the purée.
Mould around the rim, under the lid or at the spout.
tips: Always spoon a portion into a bowl rather than feeding from the container.
Write the date and time on the jar when you open it.
Check the vacuum button and the pouch seams before every use.
Never give honey to a baby under one year old — it can carry the spores that cause infant botulism.

faq.q: How long does an opened jar or pouch of baby food keep?
faq.a: 2–3 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, covered, and only if it has never been fed from directly.

faq.q: Can you feed a baby straight from the jar?
faq.a: Only if the whole jar will be finished in that feed. Once a used spoon or the baby's mouth touches it, the rest must be thrown away.

faq.q: What should you check before opening a jar of baby food?
faq.a: Press the vacuum button — it should not click. Check a pouch for swelling, leaks or damage, and discard anything that hisses or spurts when opened.

zh.name: 嬰兒副食品罐與軟袋
zh.summary: 未開封的嬰兒副食品罐與軟袋，過了上面印的有效日期就該丟掉。開封後放 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 2～3 天——而且前提是你從來沒有直接就著容器餵。
zh.pantry: 未開封的玻璃罐或軟袋經過商業加工，在有效日期之前屬於常溫商品；過了日期就丟，不要用眼睛評估。這裡不另外給常溫數字，因為容器上的日期就是製造商對自家產品的說法。請放陰涼避光處，而且每一個開封前都要檢查：真空鈕按下去會響、軟袋鼓脹滲漏破損，或開封時嘶嘶作響、噴出來的，都直接丟掉，不要開也不要用。
zh.fridge: 開封後蓋好放 4 °C 以下 2～3 天——肉類和蔬菜口味抓短的那端，酸性的水果口味可以抓長的那端。比數字更重要的是湯匙這條規則。絕對不要用進過寶寶嘴巴的湯匙直接從罐子或軟袋裡餵：口水會把細菌和酵素帶進剩下的部分，那一份會很快壞掉，也不能安全保存。請舀一份到碗裡、從碗裡餵，碗裡剩下的丟掉。直接用嘴吸軟袋口的情況也完全一樣。
zh.freezer: 開封後的罐裝與軟袋沒有公布的冷凍期限，而且市售果菜泥冷凍再解凍會嚴重分離。自己打的泥用製冰盒冷凍、凍硬後裝袋，是合理也常見的做法——但請貼上日期、把時間抓短，也不要從別的食物借一個數字過來。已經解凍、加熱或餵過的那一份，絕對不要再冷凍。
zh.thawing: 自製的冷凍份量請放冷藏解凍，絕對不要放檯面，而且只加熱一次。餵之前攪拌均勻並滴在手腕內側試溫；加熱過的泥會有局部過燙的熱點，會燙傷。
spoilage: 真空鈕按下去會響——不要打開，整罐丟掉。
軟袋鼓脹、滲漏或破損，或開封時嘶嘶作響、噴出來。
聞起來發酸、有發酵味或異味，或泥本身在冒泡。
瓶口、蓋子內側或吸嘴處出現霉。
tips: 一律舀一份到碗裡，不要就著容器餵。
開封時在罐子上寫下日期和時間。
每次使用前都檢查真空鈕和軟袋封邊。
未滿一歲的寶寶絕對不能吃蜂蜜——它可能帶有引起嬰兒肉毒桿菌中毒的孢子。

faq.q: 開封的嬰兒副食品罐可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋好放 4 °C 以下冷藏 2～3 天，而且前提是從來沒有直接從裡面餵過。

faq.q: 可以直接拿罐子餵寶寶嗎？
faq.a: 只有這一餐會整罐吃完才可以。只要餵過的湯匙或寶寶的嘴碰過，剩下的就必須丟掉。
按一下真空鈕，它不應該發出聲音。軟袋要檢查有沒有鼓脹、滲漏或破損；開封時嘶嘶響或噴出來的，全部丟掉。
